scheme_name: PM YASASVI Top Class College Education for OBC, EBC and DNT
authority: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of India
benefit: Full tuition fee reimbursement (up to ₹2.00 lakh/year) + living expenses ₹3,000/month + book grant ₹5,000/year

criteria.label: Beneficiary Category (OBC / EBC / DNT)
criteria.plain_description: Candidate must belong to Other Backward Classes (OBC), Economically Backward Classes (EBC), or De-notified Nomadic Tribes (DNT).
criteria.source_clause: PM YASASVI Guidelines Clause 3.1 - Target Group
criteria.remediation: Upload valid OBC/EBC/DNT certificate issued by competent revenue authority.

criteria.label: Admitted to notified Top Class Technical / Higher Education Institution
criteria.plain_description: Student must be enrolled in full-time graduate degree program in a recognized higher education institute.
criteria.source_clause: PM YASASVI Guidelines Clause 3.2 - Institutional Admission
criteria.remediation: Upload college bonafide certificate or admission fee receipt.

criteria.label: Annual family income ceiling (<= ₹2,50,000 per annum)
criteria.plain_description: Total family annual income from all sources must not exceed ₹2.50 Lakh.
criteria.source_clause: PM YASASVI Guidelines Clause 3.3 - Income Ceiling
criteria.remediation: Upload valid government income certificate stating family income <= ₹2.5L.

criteria.label: Aadhaar verified and bank account seeded with NPCI
criteria.plain_description: Student must have Aadhaar linked to their bank account for Direct Benefit Transfer.
criteria.remediation: Link Aadhaar with bank account and complete biometric KYC on NSP.

application.office_name: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment / College Scholarship Cell
documents_to_carry: Aadhaar Card with NPCI Bank Seeding Proof
process_steps: Complete One-Time Registration (OTR) on the National Scholarship Portal
Search scheme under Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment: PM YASASVI Top Class College Education
Upload verified caste certificate, income certificate, and college admission documents
Submit online and obtain verification from College Head of Institution (HOI)
Scholarship disbursed directly to student's bank account via DBT
